brief:
Former Israeli military chief Gadi Eisenkot is positioning himself as an alternative to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, according to Al-Monitor. Eisenkot, a reserved figure relatively new to Israeli politics, presents a contrasting profile to the veteran premier. His background leading the military distinguishes him from Netanyahu's lengthy political career.

The former commander's entry into the political arena marks a shift in Israel's leadership landscape. Eisenkot's hawkish stance appeals to voters seeking a different approach from Netanyahu's long-standing tenure.
